message:
We’ve all had those moments where we think, "I’m glad I planned ahead!" 🚗 When it comes to being prepared for emergencies on the road, having a solid plan can really make a difference. The resource we found does a great job of guiding you through what to include in your car emergency kit and how to stay safe while driving. It’s like having a little insurance policy on wheels! 

We’d love to hear your favorite tips for staying prepared on the go. What do you keep in your car just in case?
